items.heading: Kon Prek (Coconut Crab)
details: Key ingredients: coconut crab, coconut milk, onion
Clean and prepare fresh coconut crab.
Simmer the crab in coconut milk with onion.
Cook until the crab meat is tender and infused with flavor.
Serve with rice or taro.

items.heading: Pounded Taro with Coconut
details: Key ingredients: taro, coconut cream, sugar
Boil taro root until soft.
Pound the taro in a large mortar until smooth and stretchy.
Sweeten coconut cream lightly with sugar.
Serve the pounded taro with the coconut cream spooned over.
